description: Ask for an extra email address, such as info@yourdomain.com, on a domain whose email is on. It receives mail and forwards it to the main inbox, or with forward_to to the human's own mailbox such as Gmail. It costs €3 / $3 a month per extra inbox. Nothing is added or charged by this tool: it returns a confirmation link. Give the link to the human; they open it signed in, see the address, where it forwards and the price, and confirm with one button. The pro-rated part for this month is then charged to their saved payment method. Do not open or confirm the link yourself. Role addresses (admin, administrator, hostmaster, postmaster, webmaster, abuse, security) cannot forward to an outside mailbox. At most 3 a day per account. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

forward_to.description: Optional: the human's own email address to forward to. Default: the main inbox.

site.description: The address of the site whose domain has email on (from list_sites).
